question: The hematocrit indicates the:

options.opa: % in volume of hemoglobin with respect to plasma.
options.opb: Number of red blood cells per mm3.
options.opc: Volume of plasma contained in the blood.
options.opd: % in volume of red blood cells with respect to blood.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Hematocrit measures the percentage of red blood cells in the blood -> opd. % in volume of red blood cells with respect to blood -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Hematocrit indirectly reflects the hemoglobin levels in the blood -> opa. % in volume of hemoglobin with respect to plasma -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Hematocrit is used to assess the oxygen-carrying capacity of the blood -> opb. Number of red blood cells per mm3 -> 95%
analysis: The hematocrit is a measure of the percentage of red blood cells in the total volume of blood.
